description: The engine answers `400` with "The command deadline elapsed; its outcome may be unknown." when a storage command times out inside a control plane that is still forming or under load (observed against rivet-engine 3.0.0-preview.4 on Fly.io, with Tigris object storage). Type it as a retryable CommandDeadlineElapsed on every operation.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A storage command timed out inside the control plane (its outcome may be unknown): answered while the control plane is still forming or under load. Retry after a short delay.
